communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-982137321
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $89.99 on my statement from Online Marketplace. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Sarah J. Miller

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-982137321
communications.body: I attempted to contact the seller, 'ArtisanCrafts,' directly through the 'Online Marketplace' messaging system on two occasions: January 30, 2026, and February 5, 2026. On January 30, I received an automated reply stating, 'Seller will respond within 48 hours.' However, no personalized or substantive response followed. My second message on February 5 received no reply at all. Furthermore, when I tried to visit the seller's storefront on the 'Online Marketplace' today, it shows 'No items for sale' and appears to be inactive. I have no other means of reaching them.
